entity.createWhen: A source primarily describes a single named thing.

topic.createWhen: A source explains a theme, capability, or subject area.

timeline.createWhen: A source is organized around events or chronology.

faq.createWhen: The same normalized question appears repeatedly with a stable answer.

comparison.createWhen: A question or source requires comparing two or more topics or entities.

concept.createWhen: A cross-cutting idea needs its own page outside any single entity.

index.createWhen: A theme has enough connected pages that navigation is useful.
